t: The Calm Before The Natural Language Web (NLWeb)
s: The Natural Language Web (NLWeb) is emerging, enabling AI to understand and interact with websites using structured data like schema.org and LLM-generated content. This shift requires web content to be machine-readable, moving towards AI-driven web interactions.
sub: Natural Language Web (NLWeb) concept and AI interaction
Structured data (schema.org, JSON-LD, Microdata, RDFa) for machine understanding
LLM-driven dynamic content generation for an infinite web
Technical implementation challenges: state management, home-hosting experiments
